name: Christian Blended Families
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred unity of marriage as a man and wife become one flesh, highlighting the foundation for Christian blended families (Genesis 2:24). Honoring parents remains a vital commandment, even as new family structures are formed (Exodus 20:12). Families are called to serve the Lord wholeheartedly, with a commitment to raising children as a heritage from God, instructing them in His ways so they remain faithful throughout life (Joshua 24:15; Psalms 127:3; Proverbs 22:6). In Christ, all distinctions dissolve, underscoring the spiritual unity that should characterize blended families (Galatians 3:28).
